name: DIDWW Agent Skills
description: Official DIDWW agent skills: put an AI voice agent on a real DIDWW phone number with any major voice AI platform, through the DIDWW MCP (https://api.didww.com/mcp).

skills.name: didww-connect
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to ANY AI voice platform: helps choose the platform, then wires the SIP trunk pair and number. Use whenever the user wants a voice AI agent on a DIDWW number and has not committed to a platform, asks which AI platform to use with DIDWW, or names a platform that has no dedicated didww-to-X skill installed. Covers ElevenLabs, Vapi, Retell, Ultravox, Vogent, OpenAI (Realtime and GPT-Live), xAI, LiveKit and the enterprise-gated platforms.

skills.name: didww-to-elevenlabs
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to an ElevenLabs voice agent over SIP, as automatically as both platforms allow. Use whenever the user wants an ElevenLabs agent (Agents Platform, Conversational AI) on a real phone number via DIDWW, mentions pairing DIDWW with ElevenLabs, importing a SIP trunk into ElevenLabs, sip.rtc.elevenlabs.io, live-agent transfers (SIP REFER), or debugging calls between the two. Covers inbound, outbound, transfers and verification.

skills.name: didww-to-livekit
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to a LiveKit Agents worker over SIP, on LiveKit Cloud or self-hosted: inbound trunk, dispatch rule to a named agent, optional outbound trunk. Use whenever the user wants a LiveKit agent (any STT, LLM and TTS combination, including Claude as the brain) answering a real number via DIDWW, mentions sip.livekit.cloud, SIP inbound trunks or dispatch rules, lk sip commands, agent_name dispatch, or debugging calls between DIDWW and LiveKit. This is the bring-your-own-brain pairing: the agent is code the user runs.

skills.name: didww-to-openai-realtime
skills.description: Connect DIDWW phone numbers directly to OpenAI over SIP, in two separate setups the user chooses between: incoming calls answered by gpt-realtime (Realtime API, webhook backend, optional transfer to a live person), and outbound calls placed by GPT-Live (Live API) through a DIDWW outbound trunk with its username and password. Use whenever the user wants an OpenAI voice agent on a DIDWW number, mentions sip.api.openai.com, realtime.call.incoming webhooks, Realtime SIP, GPT-Live, gpt-live-1, /v1/live/sessions, outbound AI calls from OpenAI, or debugging calls between DIDWW and OpenAI. Developer-grade: the agent is code the user runs.

skills.name: didww-to-retell
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to a Retell AI agent over custom telephony, with full MCP automation: Retell's official MCP can create agents AND import numbers. Use whenever the user wants a Retell agent on a real phone number via DIDWW, mentions pairing DIDWW with Retell, custom telephony, sip.retellai.com, import-phone-number, or debugging calls between the two.

skills.name: didww-to-ultravox
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to an Ultravox Realtime voice agent over SIP. Use whenever the user wants an Ultravox agent on a real phone number via DIDWW, mentions pairing DIDWW with Ultravox, an account SIP domain, agent_ addresses, allowedCidrRanges, or debugging calls between the two. Covers the address-based routing model that makes Ultravox different from every number-import platform.

skills.name: didww-to-vapi
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to a Vapi assistant over BYO SIP trunking, as automatically as Vapi allows. Use whenever the user wants a Vapi assistant on a real phone number via DIDWW, mentions pairing DIDWW with Vapi, byo-sip-trunk credentials, sip.vapi.ai, or debugging calls between the two. Covers inbound, outbound, transfers and agent binding, following Vapi's and DIDWW's own DIDWW guides.

skills.name: didww-to-vogent
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to a Vogent voice agent over SIP import. Use whenever the user wants a Vogent agent on a real phone number via DIDWW, mentions pairing DIDWW with Vogent, sip_import numbers, sip.vogent.ai, warm transfers from a Vogent agent to a live person, or debugging calls between the two.

skills.name: didww-to-xai
skills.description: Connect a DIDWW phone number to an xAI Grok Voice agent over SIP (xAI's docs and console now say SpaceXSI). Use whenever the user wants Grok answering a real phone number via DIDWW, mentions sip.voice.x.ai, xAI or Grok voice agents, the Voice Agent Builder, console.x.ai, a Direct SIP number, agent_id, realtime.call.incoming webhooks, or debugging calls between DIDWW and Grok. Covers incoming calls and transfers to a live person; xAI places no outbound calls.
